title: Simple, Distraction Free, Free
body: A very rare kind of app which focuses on doing exactly what it’s supposed to do and not get distracted in frills and whistles. Allows me to track habits relevant to me, see summary for different time frames and export data for nerdy kind. All this without asking for my personal details and trying to get me to buy stuff. Thank you very much to the creator for making something so useful free for everyone

title: Exactly what’s needed

author: Veda Maddipati

title: Best habit tracker App, serves the purpose better than all the alternatives. + it’s free!
body:
I have tried like 20+ apps including notion, atoms, etc but this one’s the best in my personal opinion.

Suggestions to developers:

1) please consider adding an interactive home screen widget to reduce friction further and to make it even easier to track and stick to the habits.

2) i urge you to please keep the app free as long as possible.

3) it would be great if it were possible to sync it across both the iPad and iPhone.

Thank-you so much for making this app!
